text:
Data Engineer, logistics

We're a logistics startup, and we're hiring a Data Engineer. The pipelines you build will help packages arrive on time and on budget.

We recently closed a $12M Series A. The team is 60 people, so your work will be visible from your first day, and you'll have room to build your own ideas without a lot of process in the way.

You'll work with dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. The job is to build pipelines that scale and to improve our data models so teams across the company can trust the numbers they use.

You can work remotely four days a week.

If you like hard problems and want to work on something that physically moves goods around, we'd like to hear from you.
